iut_type: End Product (Panasonic Automotive Systems), RF PHY test scope for preliminary test-mode verification
customer_question: (In the context of the informal preliminary test-mode check) The full formal RF PHY test for our module covers 34 items across 1M, 2M, Stable Mod Index Tx, and Stable Mod Index Rx modes, quoted at ¥1,000,000. Do we need to run all of that for just a preliminary test-mode and mandatory-function verification?
question_variants: Can RF PHY test scope be reduced for a preliminary, non-certification-grade check?
Which specific subset of RF PHY items is sufficient to confirm test mode and mandatory functions?
actual_issue: The customer assumed the full 34-item RF PHY test scope (covering multiple modes) would be needed even for an early, informal verification check, when a much smaller scope would actually suffice for that specific, narrower purpose.
plain_english_explanation: For confirming test-mode entry and mandatory-function pass/fail behavior specifically (as opposed to the complete formal certification test), it isn't necessary to run the full 34-item RF PHY scope across all supported modes (1M, 2M, Stable Mod Index Tx, Stable Mod Index Rx) — a much narrower scope of just 10 items under 1M mode alone is sufficient to confirm test mode and mandatory functionality, reducing the cost from ¥1,000,000 (full scope) to ¥400,000 (1M-only, 10-item scope) for this preliminary purpose.
consultant_answer: No, you don't need the full 34-item scope for this preliminary check — confirming test mode entry and mandatory-function behavior only requires the 10 items under 1M mode alone, bringing the cost down to ¥400,000 instead of the ¥1,000,000 full-scope test. Please let us know if you'd like to proceed with this reduced scope for the preliminary verification.
decision_logic: RF PHY test scope should be tailored to the actual purpose at hand — a preliminary test-mode/mandatory-function check needs only a narrow subset of items (1M mode, 10 items) rather than the complete multi-mode formal certification scope (34 items), since the preliminary check's goal doesn't require validating every supported mode.
final_recommendation: When a customer requests a preliminary or informal verification check, proactively recommend a reduced test scope appropriate to that specific narrower purpose, rather than defaulting to the full formal certification scope and its associated cost.
risk_if_done_wrong: Quoting the full 34-item RF PHY scope for what's actually just a preliminary test-mode check would unnecessarily inflate the cost of an early verification step that doesn't require validating every supported mode.
